ABHAY KUMAR TIWARI
Rajnagar Extension, Ghaziabad, UP - 201017
abhay1672@gmail.com,  +91-9711669421

DOB-30-06-1989

Lead Java Full Stack Architect | 11.6 Years in Enterprise Solutions, Cloud-Native Microservices, Multi-Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and Emerging Tech (AI/ML)

Professional Summary

Seasoned Software Architect & Technical Leader with 11.6 years of experience in designing and delivering scalable enterprise applications across Finance, Retail, Telecom, and IoT. Specialized in Java, Spring, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, and Multi-Cloud Deployments. Proven expertise in modernization, performance optimization, and cost-effective cloud adoption. Adept at leading teams, defining solution architecture, and aligning technology with business goals. Exposure to AI/ML-driven solutions and real-time data analytics.

Core Competencies

Architecture & Design: Microservices, Event-Driven Systems, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Serverless, API Gateway

Enterprise Solutions: Java 8/11/17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, RESTful APIs, Kafka, RabbitMQ

Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda), Azure (Functions, App Services), GCP (App Engine, Cloud SQL), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins

Performance Engineering: Scalability, Cloud Cost Optimization, Observability (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana)

Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis

Security: OAuth2, JWT, Spring Security, RBAC

Team Leadership: Agile/Scrum, Code Reviews, Mentoring, Cross-Functional Collaboratio

Professional Experience

Technology Lead 

Infogain India Pvt. Ltd.  –  Noida, UP                                                                                        Dec 2024 – Now

Architected cloud-native microservices ensuring high scalability and maintainability.

Designed and governed enterprise API strategy improving system interoperability.

Mentored 5+ developers; established best practices in DevOps, CI/CD, and secure coding.

Optimized legacy systems, reducing application response times by 30% and improving reliability.

Senior Technical Lead

HCL Technologies Ltd.  –  Noida, UP                                                                                    Jun 2021– Dec 2023

Defined solution architecture for financial applications processing 1M+ daily transactions.

Implemented CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes) cutting deployment time by 40%.

Enhanced application security with OAuth2, Spring Security & role-based controls.

Partnered with product managers and clients to align technical solutions with business KPIs.

Software Developer

Jellyfish Technologies Pvt. Ltd. – Noida, UP                                                                     Sept 2020 – May 2021

Developed full-stack applications using Spring MVC & Angular.

Improved database performance by 20% through query optimization.

Achieved 90% test coverage ensuring production stability.



Senior Software Developer

Spectrum Data System Services Pvt. Ltd. – Noida, UP                                                         Jun 2016 – Sept 2020

Migrated legacy systems to modern Spring Boot microservices.

Drove adoption of cloud-first strategies, improving deployment efficiency.

Delivered retail & healthcare domain applications with focus on scalability.

Earlier Roles                                                                                                                        April 2013 – Jun 2016

NCR Eduservices / Tutor Bucket Pvt. Ltd. – Built and maintained enterprise-grade Java EE applications, led school management and online tutoring platforms, and introduced ORM with Hibernate.

Education

BTech -- AKTU – [2013, 60.3%], RKGIT, Ghaziabad, UP

XII – CBSE – [2007, 63%], Kendriya Vidyalaya, 39 GTC, Varanasi, UP

X – CBSE – [2004, 72%], Raj English School, Varanasi, UP 

Key Projects

Costco Wholesale – Performance Engineering & Cloud Migration (2024–2025)

Led cloud cost optimization, reducing expenses by 20%.

Migrated enterprise workloads from Azure to GCP ensuring stability & scalability.

Partnered with performance teams to fine-tune high-volume workloads.

Mastercard Credit Card Approval System – Mastercard R&D, Pune (2022–2023)

Architected microservices-based system handling 1M+ transactions/day.

Implemented Kafka messaging for asynchronous processing.

Secured financial APIs with Spring Security & OAuth2.

Manchester United Digital Portal – Manchester, UK (2021–2022)

Designed and developed CMS architecture with Spring Boot & Angular.

Integrated Elasticsearch for optimized content retrieval.

Deployed on AWS Cloud for scalability and availability.

Trackimo IoT GPS Tracking – Tel Aviv, Israel (2020–2021)

Developed real-time GPS tracking system with Spring Boot & PostgreSQL.

Leveraged Kafka for real-time data streaming.

Secured system with JWT authentication & RBAC.

Airtel Broadband – FireTV Data Quota Solution (2019–2020)

Designed a quota-based broadband plan system for FireTV users.

Built APIs for real-time quota management and plan approvals.

Improved customer satisfaction with scalable usage monitoring system.

Technical Skills

Languages: Java 8/11/17, SQL, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, SASS

Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, Angular, React, Node.js

Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible

Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis

Monitoring & Observability: ELK, Prometheus, Grafana

Collaboration Tools: GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Confluence
